commands: sh -c "[ -r /etc/ssh/sshd_config ] || exit 2; grep -i AllowTcpForwarding /etc/ssh/sshd_config | grep -v '^#'; STF_PRC=\$?; if [ \$STF_PRC -eq 1 ]; then printf '%s\n' ptxray_absent_allowtcpforwarding; exit 0; fi; exit \$STF_PRC"
blurb: This check verifies that the SSH daemon has TCP forwarding turned off. TCP forwarding lets an authenticated SSH session relay TCP connections through the host, so a session that should only provide a shell can reach other network services.
